== Book 4 ==

== Biography ==

L. Frank Baum is credited on the title page as writer of the account, alongside illustrator John R. Neill. The dedication names Harriet A. B. Neal. In a preface addressed to readers, Baum acknowledges that "the books are partly yours," crediting readers' suggestions for guiding the telling of the stories and calling their assistance "clever and thoughtful."
